description: Soo dejiso moodeelka lagula taliyay si aad u bilowdo sheekada, ama ku dhex baadh Hub moodeel kale.
quickStartFailed: Waxbaa qaldamay. Fadlan mar kale isku day.
checkModelWaiting: {{model}} ({{size}}) diyaar u ah in la soo dejiyo
checkEngineGpuUnused: {{backend}} waa dhismo loogu talagalay CPU oo keliya, sidaas darteed {{gpus}} wuu fadhiisan doonaa. Xulo backend GPU ee Settings si aad u isticmaasho.
checkEngineVendorMismatch: {{backend}} waxa uu u baahan yahay {{vendor}} GPU, laakin Novera ayaa helay {{gpus}}. Novera waxa uu ku shaqeyn doonaa CPU.
checkEngineRuntimeUnreachable: {{backend}} ma gaari karo GPU, sidaas darteed Novera waxa uu ku shaqeyn doonaa CPU. Tani badanaa waxay ka dhigan tahay in darawalka GPU ama waqtiga socodka uu u baahan yahay cusbooneysiin.
checkEngineMissingLibrary: {{backend}} ma bilaaban karo sababtoo ah maktabad loo baahan yahay ayaa maqan ({{libraries}}), sidaas darteed Novera waxa uu ku shaqeyn doonaa CPU.
checkEngineProbeFailed: Lama xaqiijin karo in mashiinka uu isticmaali karo GPU
checkEngineUnavailable: Dhismihiisa mashiinkan ma soo sheegi karo xaaladda GPU
checkSearchNoVector: Muunadda isku xidhka ma soo celin wax natiijo ah, sidaa darteed raadinta faylka weli shaqayn mayso
checkSearchInvalidVector: Muunadda isku xidhka waxay soo celisay natiijo aan la isticmaali karin, sidaa darteed raadinta faylka waxaa laga yaabaa inaysan waxba soo celin
checkSearchProbeFailed: Lama xaqiijin karo muunadda isku xidhka
checkSearchUnavailable: Nooca matoorkani ma xaqiijin karo muunadda isku xidhka
welcomeTitle: Novera waxaa u baahan in lagu dejiyo nidaamkaaga
welcomeBody: Tani waxay qaadaneysaa dhowr daqiiqo: Novera waxay soo dejin doontaa matoorkeeda xukunka iyo muunad yar oo raadinta faylasha. Waxaad weli isticmaali kartaa kombiyuutarkaaga inta uu socdo.
otherWarnings: {{count}} kormeerro kale ayaa sidoo kale u baahan fiiro gaar ah.
setupDoneBody: Novera wuxuu ku shaqeyn doonaa moodooyinka maxaliga ah oo leh llama.cpp.
dsparkDescription: Waxay soo dejisaa faylka kaabaya ee DSpark Q8_0 ({{size}}) ee LFM2.5-2.6B. Waxay dedejin kartaa soo saarista jawaabaha, balse waxay isticmaashaa RAM ama VRAM dheeraad ah, taasoo yaraynaysa xusuusta u hadhay macnaha guud (context). Ku tijaabi qalabkaaga; hagaaji dhererka macnaha guud ama dami habka saadaalinta (speculative decoding) ee dejinta moodeelka.
